response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang skills, but the profile fundamentally mismatches this role. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no embedded networking or LAN-switch experience, no Linux kernel modification work, and no exposure to the required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal). Limited C experience from a brief 2014-2015 stint does not meet the 'strong proficiency in C for UNIX' bar.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, and backend
Some low-level exposure: C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, Linux familiarity
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and open-source contributions
concerns: No indication of Japanese language ability, which is a mandatory requirement
No embedded firmware, network switch, or L2/L3 networking protocol development experience
No Linux kernel analysis/modification or security-feature (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption) background
